subject: Late-stage candidate handoff: interviewer bridging and debrief plan
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Late-stage candidate handoff: interviewer bridging and debrief plan

Hey team,

We have Eleanor Wu (Data Scientist, late-stage) in final onsite loop next week but Emma (recruiter) is unexpectedly OOO starting Monday. Candidate is flexible but wants a single-day loop on Oct 22. We need to cover two behavioral interviews (leadership / collaboration) and one systems deep-dive.

Ask: can one of you pick up the behavioral debrief and commit to running the post-loop debrief the same afternoon? If not, suggest a backup and we’ll make a quick swap. I attached her resume and the candidate pack.

Constraints:
- Systems interviewer: Laura is scheduled for 10/22 11:00–11:45 (confirmed)
- Hiring manager (Carlos) can join for debrief at 4:00pm PT if we can do a 3:30 fallback debrief window
- Candidate prefers morning start but can do midday if needed

I can own scheduling logistics / calendar updates. Please reply ASAP — need to finalize by EOD today so Emma doesn’t have to triage while OOO.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: eleanor_resume.pdf, candidate-pack.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Oct 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Late-stage candidate handoff: interviewer bridging and debrief plan

Sofia — I can take the leadership / collaboration interview and run the debrief at 3:30 if Laura can wrap by 11:45 and we space the loop. My availability on 10/22 is open after 1pm PT, but I can shift to the morning if we make the behavioral slot 9:45–10:30.

If you want to keep the candidate morning-preferred start, schedule like: 9:45 leadership (Marissa), 11:00 systems (Laura), lunch break, 2:00 org match with Carlos + debrief 3:30. I’ll fill the leadership slot.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Recruiter (Hiring Ops)
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Oct 2025 11:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Late-stage candidate handoff: interviewer bridging and debrief plan

Quick note — I’m out for client calls until 2pm PT on 10/22 so can’t do the morning behavioral. If Marissa has it covered that’s ideal. If we need a backup for the leadership interview, Karthik said he can step in for 9:45–10:30 on short notice (loop in Karthik).

Also, Laura — can you confirm you’re able to stay on for a brief sync right after your systems interview if Carlos is flexible? If not, we’ll push debrief to 4:00 and Marissa can still do the 3:30 pre-brief quick sync.

Ben
Ben Carter
Manager, Sales Engineering (covers candidate-facing technical interviews)
[Note: forwarded candidate resume to my calendar invite for context]

Thanks everyone — firming up final plan below and updating calendars now.

Final schedule (Oct 22, onsite loop — candidate will be remote via Zoom):
- 09:30–10:15: Leadership / collaboration — Marissa Cole (confirmed)
- 11:00–11:45: Systems deep-dive — Laura Bennett (confirmed)
- 14:00–14:35: Org / culture match — Karthik Iyer (backup for Ben; confirmed)
- 15:30–16:00: Panel debrief (internal only) — Marissa to lead; Carlos to join at 16:00 if available for final check-in

Notes / logistics:
- Candidate prefers morning; we honored by starting at 09:30. Eleanor confirmed she can bring a laptop; no special environment required beyond basic Python.
- Attached: candidate-pack.pdf (copy to interviewers), debrief-eval-form.xlsx. Please fill the evaluation form within 24 hours of the loop.
- If anything changes, page me and I’ll coordinate swaps.

Appreciate the quick turnaround on this. Leaving both Marissa and Karthik as behavioral backups gave us resilience while Emma is OOO.

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference
[Attachments: candidate-pack.pdf, debrief-eval-form.xlsx]
